newsitem.title: CANADA: Arakis Energy makes Sudan discovery.
newsitem.headline: Arakis Energy makes Sudan discovery.

text.p: Arakis Energy Corp said it made a third major oil find in the Sudan near its South Toma discovery.

The oil exploration company said its El Nar 2a well has been drilled to a target depth of 2,445 metres and penetrated a gross oil column of 120 metres (net 60 metres) in the Bentiu 1 formation, with additional potential in the Bentiu 2.
Arakis said net pay, porosity and water saturation are comparable to the South Toma well, which had an indicated producing rate in excess of 10,000 barrels of oil per day based on production.
The company said the drilling rig has been moved and is rigging up on a delineation well location on the company's major 1996 discovery, the El Toor structure.
